component.name: Jubako
component.summary: A simple desktop database, in the spirit of Microsoft Access

description.p: Make a database, put a spreadsheet in it, look at your rows, print a tidy list. No SQL to learn, no server to set up, no account to make.

ul.li: Import CSV and Excel files; Jubako works out the column types
Browse and edit rows in a grid, or one at a time in a form
Saved views, lookups between tables, and reports that fit the page
Export to CSV, Excel or PDF, or print
One SQLite file per database, or keep it on PostgreSQL or MySQL
A command line and an MCP server, so agents can do the same jobs

description.p: Made for Omarchy, where it follows the desktop theme, and at home on any Linux desktop.
